messages:
elaine (Docs): FYI I opened PR #482 to add guidance for legal holds on audit exports. specific ask: wording that explains how a preservation request pauses TTL and the export path. Please review + quick signoff from legal/compliance before we merge.

mike (Legal): Thanks — will take a look. Is there a short sentence we can use that doesn't create an implied SLA? We should avoid words like 'will retain' without qualifiers. :thinking_face:

sanjay (Compliance): Suggest: 'Audit log retention TTL may be extended or suspended for documented legal preservation requests; customers must submit a valid preservation request through support with case ID.' Keeps it scoped. Thoughts?

kelly (Eng): One implementation note: when TTL is suspended we still redact PII on export if bucket-level redaction is enabled. I added a small code snippet to the PR showing export-with-hold semantics:

```
# pseudo-config
audit_retention:
  default_ttl_days: 365
  legal_hold:
    enabled: true
    suspend_ttl: true
    requires_case_id: true
```

elaine (Docs): Nice, kelly. Can we add a one-line callout about how exports behave with redaction enabled vs disabled? The current doc only mentions retention.

mike (Legal): Agreed on callout. Proposed legal-approved wording: 'A documented legal preservation request may suspend the configured retention period for relevant audit records; such requests do not bypass configured data redaction controls.' Short and conservative.

sanjay (Compliance): LGTM. Also add a short note about export audit trail: who exported, export timestamp, and case ID included in export metadata. That's important for evidence.

elaine (Docs): I'll add two small subsections: (1) legal hold language (mike's sentence) and (2) export metadata example. Draft in PR now.

docs-bot: Linked PR #482 -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 (preview: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/482)

kelly (Eng): Quick heads-up — SDK snippet change required in the Python export client. I left a TODO comment with the sample call here: `client.exports.create(audit_log=True, case_id="CASE-1234")` so the docs snippet and the client match.

mike (Legal): One more tiny ask: can we avoid stating retention durations in the legal language (keep durations in the retention policy table only)? That way legal holds don't conflict with the policy page.

elaine (Docs): Good catch. I'll remove any hard TTL numbers from the legal-hold paragraph and reference the retention policy table instead. Updating now, will ping when ready for final review. :thumbsup:

sanjay (Compliance): Ping me when updated, will give final ack.

elaine (Docs): Updated and pushed. pinging @mike @sanjay for final signoff.

mike (Legal): Reviewed and approved.

sanjay (Compliance): Approved from compliance. Merge away. :white_check_mark:
